name: Magicsea Online
summary:
Do you like online games with friends and MMORPG online? Welcome to the uninhabited island of adventure! "Magicsea Online" is an epic multiplayer role-playing game where you will find an open world full of adventures! Epic RPG adventures, corsairs, battles and battles await you! The battle for the pirates' treasure has already begun!

Embark on an exciting sea adventure in the MMORPG Online game "Magicsea Online"! Become a legendary pirate, brave dangers and explore the vast expanses of ocean and land. Create your crew, fight enemies, collect treasures and build your pirate empire. Epic RPG adventures, corsairs, battles and battles await you. Meet new friends and enemies, explore dungeons in search of riches and glory. Your battle for pirate treasure in the world of "Magicsea Online" is just beginning!
